did: Built a game's moment log on server claude/gwb-moments-log (slow lane, no PR): every play as the scenarios it was, in the same shape as just happened plus its quarter and clock, served to a paired phone for any week's game, with just happened now reading the same per-play function. Found that the list of takes already carries each bite's matched play id, so the phone only had to read it. A fresh review's findings were fixed or recorded. On the coordinator's call, a play keeps its own unit after the final, while a new bite said after it is still about the game (engine version 7).

calls.title: Serve a game's whole moment log rather than its missed moments (C1006)
options: the whole log, every reading of it on the phone
calls.why: Missed moments, just happened and later the chains are all readings of one log, so the server serves the record and not a policy.
calls.undo: Delete the games route and moment_log.

calls.title: The log keeps going while the game feed is paused (C1008)
options: the log is a record and only stops growing
calls.why: The socket hides stale offers when paused, but a log of plays already seen is still true.
calls.undo: Read the feed's switch in moment_log.

left: The route's contract in some-ui waits on the route snapshot after the server merges.
A play with no ESPN sequence number sorts to the start of the log.
